title: Best Of Bali | FREE Balinese Couple Massage
highlights: Enjoy the Kecak fire dance performance at Uluwatu Temple, where traditional dance and dramatic sunset create an unforgettable cultural experience.
Experience the romance of Bali, where sunset strolls along pristine beaches, dinners under the stars, and amazing moments in lush rice terraces create unforgettable memories.
Indulge in a Balinese massage experience, where rhythmic strokes, acupressure, and aromatic oils come together to offer a deeply relaxing experience.
Set sail on a thrilling Pirate Dinner Cruise, where lively pirate-themed entertainment, delicious cuisine, and stunning ocean views create an unforgettable evening.
Explore the stunning Tegallalang Rice Terraces, where tiered landscapes of lush greenery create a serene atmosphere and offer a glimpse into Bali’s traditional farming culture.
overview:
About the Tour:
Bali paints a perfect romantic picture with its tropical weather, enchanting culture, and stunning landscapes. From the lush green vistas of Ubud to the alluring beaches in the south, Bali is an ideal getaway for peace-seeking honeymooners and adventure enthusiasts alike. To add even more charm to your honeymoon, this tour includes a day excursion to Nusa Penida Island, where you'll encounter amazing rock formations, sea views, and a variety of water sports activities.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Ubud | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Welcome to Bali! Upon arrival at Ngurah Rai Airport, get transferred to your hotel in Ubud. After check-in, spend the rest of your day at leisure, where you can relax or explore the city on your own. You can visit the ancient Goa Gajah Temple and admire its intricate cave carvings, or visit the vibrant Bali Bird Park, home to a stunning collection of exotic birds. Also, you can visit the Waterbom Waterpark, Bali's top spot for thrilling water rides. Later, return to your hotel on your own.

days.title: Kintamani Highlighlands with Tegallalang Rice Terraces & Tegenungan Waterfall
days.desc: In the morning, board your transfer and begin your Central Bali tour with a visit to the stunning Tegenungan Waterfall. Once there, soak in its natural beauty and continue to the famous Tegallalang Rice Terraces, renowned for their tiered green landscapes. Next, visit the Kintamani Highlands for amazing views of Mount Batur and its volcanic caldera. Also, you can try the unique Luwak coffee (optional) and feel the adrenaline on the exhilarating Bali Swing. Afterwards, get driven to your hotel.

days.title: Balinese Spa Experience | Transfer to Kuta
days.desc: Post check-out, get transferred for a soothing Balinese spa experience, where traditional massage techniques and natural oils will leave you feeling completely rejuvenated. After a relaxing experience, get transferred to Kuta, soaking in the amazing views. Post check-in, you can explore Kuta on your own, where you can visit Kedonganan Beach, famous for its fresh seafood, or indulge in shopping at the vibrant Kuta Art Market for local crafts and souvenirs. Later, return to your hotel on your own.

days.title: Water Sports at Tanjung Benoa | Pirate Dinner Cruise Experience
days.desc: Today, board your transfer from the hotel and get driven to Benoa Harbor for thrilling water activities like jet skiing, banana boat rides, parasailing, and more (at an extra cost). Later, get transferred to the Sea Safari pier for a stunning Pirate Dinner Cruise experience. Once there, board your cruise and savor your dinner while getting entertained by live music, traditional Balinese dance, and fire dance. After an amazing day, get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Nusa Penida Island West Tour
days.desc: In the morning, board your transfer to Sanur Harbor and hop on a speedboat to Nusa Penida. Start with a visit to Kelingking Beach, known for its iconic T-Rex-shaped cliff and stunning views. Next, visit Angel’s Billabong, a natural infinity pool, where you can indulge in a refreshing swim. Continue to Broken Bay and marvel at its unique natural arch and visit the Bubu Beach, where you can opt for snorkeling to explore vibrant marine life. Later, get driven to your hotel for an overnight stay.
